name: Ding Xiu
source:
A graduate of the Web assasin school, he has been Zhang Lei's bodyguard since Wolf's death.
He is proud of being praised by Master Ma as having the second best fighting skills among his students.
He has a respectful attitude towards his seniors, but when he perceives them as enemies, he shows no mercy.
He left with Zhang Lei when Zhang Lei parted ways with the Web.
In fact, he is best at spear fighting with long arms.
He admires Jack, whom Master Ma admires the most.
